steps.name: per-tab-ms
steps.js: const out={}; for (const t of ['tree','helpers','flowers','garden','bonus','tree']) { const t0=performance.now(); document.querySelector('.tab[data-tab='+t+']').click(); document.body.offsetHeight; const t1=performance.now(); await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(r))); out[t]=[Math.round(t1-t0), Math.round(performance.now()-t1)]; } return out;

steps.name: frame-sheet-open-ms
steps.js: const f=[]; let last=performance.now(); await new Promise(r=>{ let n=0; function s(t){ f.push(t-last); last=t; if(++n<60) requestAnimationFrame(s); else r(); } requestAnimationFrame(s); }); f.sort((a,b)=>a-b); return {med: Math.round(f[30]), p95: Math.round(f[57])};

steps.name: profile-render
steps.js: const UI=R.ui; const t0=performance.now(); for(let i=0;i<20;i++) UI.renderPanel && UI.renderPanel(true); return Math.round((performance.now()-t0)/20*10)/10 + ' ms/render';
